 A tiny slug package used for a smoke test.
+
+## Usage
+
+Here are two usage examples:
+
+```python
+from slug import slugify
+
+# Example 1: Convert a simple string to a slug
+slugify("Hello World")
+# Returns: 'hello-world'
+
+# Example 2: Convert a title with multiple words
+slugify("My Blog Post Title")
+# Returns: 'my-blog-post-title'
+```
